scope: Every sparse-page candidate in the independently checked staged ancillary preflight; no HTML, CSS, renderer or PDF mutation performed.
review_method: Read complete extracted text for each of the 60 candidates.
Measured actual PDF page/text/ink geometry for all 60 candidate pages.
Raster-inspected all 60 candidate pages in four numbered contact sheets.
Inspected all pages around the substantive 00373, 00605, 00720 and 00806 cases in a separate contact sheet.
Read related print CSS and source HTML to identify common template causes.
non_goals: No clinical wording, medication, source reference, table cell, source-bound interval or QR was removed or edited.
Recommendations concern pagination only. The two signature lines on support-tail pages do not constitute intentional full-page writing areas.
Low word count alone was not treated as an error: 00373 test cards are explicitly accepted.

journey_review_question_tail.reason: Closing review-question box and source footer alone at the top of a new landscape page. No patient record area or distinct chapter justifies the blank remainder. Preserve the complete urgent-symptom sentence and questions when repaginating.
journey_review_question_tail.template_cause: The `.journey-handoff` closing box retains break-inside:avoid; the preceding checks consume the prior page and the closing box/footer overflow.

journey_source_footer_only.reason: Only the source-review footer has moved to a new page; the page has no substantive content.
journey_source_footer_only.template_cause: End-of-journey `.journey-footer` is not kept with preceding content.

endocrine_forced_check_page_break.reason: Two or three complete table rows continue on this sparse middle page, but the explanations and questions are forced onto the next page despite ample space. Retain every table cell and move the following explanatory cards up through natural pagination.
endocrine_forced_check_page_break.template_cause: The older `.endocrine-suite.suite-journey .journey-checks { display:block; break-before:page }` selector in endocrine-v0842.css has greater specificity than the new `.journey-print .journey-checks { break-before:auto }`, leaving an avoidable middle-page gap.

support_web_navigation_only.reason: Only an Open-one-phase navigation list, or its last few links, prints on the extra page. These links are a web fallback, not clinical instructions or a record page.
support_web_navigation_only.template_cause: The `<noscript>` fallback phase-navigation list remains printable after the renderer explicitly reveals all authored phases.

support_signature_and_sources_tail.reason: Only two signature/rescue-completion lines and source notes, with optional web navigation, overflow onto the new page. This is not an intentional writing sheet: the form lines are confined to its top. Keep the lines attached to their phase prescription.
support_signature_and_sources_tail.template_cause: The ending signature/rescue paragraph and `.sources` are allowed to separate from the phase-specific support section; `<noscript>` phase navigation adds unnecessary print height.

support_verification_signature_tail.reason: The before-signing checklist, signature/rescue lines, source note and phase links are isolated on a largely empty ending page. All checklist and completion text should be retained with its phase, not removed as boilerplate.
support_verification_signature_tail.template_cause: The final pre-signing/checklist and signature blocks are not kept near their associated prescription and print-only space is consumed by web fallback navigation.

support_source_navigation_tail.reason: Only source/verification notes and phase-navigation links remain on the page; no prescription table or independent clinical section is present. Keep required source/verification text near the preceding support phase and suppress only web navigation in print.
support_source_navigation_tail.template_cause: The `.sources` footer overflows, followed by the printable `<noscript>` phase fallback list.

logistics_footer_only.reason: Only the source-review and SACTCheck footer has overflowed onto a fresh portrait page.
logistics_footer_only.template_cause: `.endocrine-footer` is separated from the preceding logistics/evidence section.

logistics_evidence_tail.reason: The last two evidence references, source-review note and footer are stranded on the second page. Retain the citations while reflowing them with the preceding source section.
logistics_evidence_tail.template_cause: The ending source list and `.endocrine-footer` flow beyond a nearly full first page.

logistics_final_access_card.reason: Only step 7, Help with the daily plan, and its source note occupy the top fifth of a new portrait page. This is the final item of a continuous seven-step list, with no new chapter or record area. Preserve the whole card while reducing preventable grid/card spacing.
logistics_final_access_card.template_cause: An odd final `.access-step` grid item is pushed after the first three two-column rows, followed by `.access-note`.

logistics_line_care_tail.reason: One PICC-care paragraph and its source note are stranded on the final page. Keep the complete fever/redness/swelling/pain/leakage/damage advice with the rest of the access-device section.
logistics_line_care_tail.template_cause: The last `.access-details > details` block and `.access-note` overflow after the practical steps on page 1.

meaningful_named_test_cards.reason: The page has its own Tests-in-your-plan heading and two complete, readable LDH and CK/creatinine cards with timing, purpose and symptom advice. It uses roughly 47% of the landscape page height. This is substantive graphical content, not an orphan note or blank page; no mandatory compaction is recommended.
meaningful_named_test_cards.template_cause: A structured `.sc44-monitoring-details` block follows the preceding monitoring matrix; complete cards are kept together for readability.

results.text:
PICC care and urgent line symptoms
A PICC usually needs regular dressing and flushing appointments even between treatments. Fever, redness, swelling, pain, leakage or
damage requires prompt advice. Your hospital supplies the exact care instructions.
Sources: NCCP 00936 v1 · official regimen · eviQ · implanted port patient information. Source reconciled; independent clinical, pharmacy and patient/PPI review pending.
